description: Place a YES or NO stake using free nonredeemable play credits with no cash value. Anyone with the market ID and a signed wallet may participate. Hard caps: 5 credits per bet and 25 credits per market. POST /api/second-date-bet. API access costs 0.10 USDC per call on Base mainnet using x402 exact, under the existing shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. This access fee is separate from play-credit stakes. Each wallet begins with 25 free play credits. X-Wever-Wallet-Proof binds the exact JSON arguments and API path. Human consent and reports use https://weverlabs.com/second-dates/. Betting closes at the deadline or first human report. Missing reports return stakes seven days after the close. Keep request_id and exact arguments for retry; use a new request_id for current status. Read /api/second-dates-contract for schemas and public receipt verification key.
name: wever_second-date-bet
